I'm selling my Tesla after 7 years and 60,000 miles. Elon made it easy.
As a result of Elon Musk and DOGE, my wife lost her job at U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service. Because my wife is a rad lady, I'm disappointed this happened, and selling my Tesla Model 3 Performance. In this video, we'll cover the following topics:
• What happened, and why did my wife get fired?
• What has it been like owning a Tesla Model 3 for 7 years?
• How much has it cost for the Tesla for 7 years?
• Elon Musk's overpromise and underdeliver strategy
• What are the best features of the Model 3 Performance?
